1) 10:00 — Arrival, badging, coffee
2) 10:30 — 20–25m product walkthrough + Q&A
3) 11:00 — 30m security deep-dive with Evan
4) 11:40 — next steps / mutual action plan

I'll create a calendar invite once we have the NDA signed and confirm room A-3 (small conference) or A-1 (larger demo room) depending on your AV needs.

Alex Martinez
